reviewPurpose: Review a primary conference abstract as a fish-survey source lead for the two Laguna reservoirs without promoting abstract claims into the application.

source.title: Assessment of Fish Diversity and Distribution and Water Quality in Lakes Caliraya and Lumot in Laguna, Philippines
source.publisher: Asian Association for Biology Education; Asian Journal of Biology Education
source.publication: Asian Journal of Biology Education, Volume 14, September 2022, conference paper abstracts, printed page 40
source.checkedContent: Publisher-hosted complete journal-volume PDF reviewed online; the conference abstract on printed page 40 was read. No local PDF copy is retained.
source.copyrightEvidence: The volume front matter states Copyright ©2004 by the AJBE Editing and Publishing Office. All rights reserved. No item-specific open license or permission for the 2022 abstract or underlying study table was verified.

abstractReportedFactsHeld.gearAndEffortSummary: The abstract describes several fishing gears and two hours of collection at each site.

reuseReview.decision: Keep every study-derived taxon and aggregate claim held outside public species projections until the complete source table and reuse basis are reviewed.
notes: The issue PDF is openly accessible, but its front matter states all rights reserved; accessibility is not treated as reuse permission.
No full species table, exact field dates or item-specific reuse license was verified.
No email, permission request, login, payment, or access-control bypass was made.

nonClaims: The study's reported richness is not a complete or current reservoir checklist.
Abstract-reported dominant taxa are not admitted as public species-presence assertions.
No stocking, aquaculture, capture location, exact sampling date, current abundance, catchability, legality, safety or geometry is inferred.
This source does not supersede the bounded GBIF locality review or establish fish absence from any waterbody.
nextActions: Check whether the authors or publisher provide the full species table and exact sampling-period details.
Verify item-specific reuse terms before transcribing or publishing any species-level claim.
If permission or a reusable source is unavailable, retain the lead as held and search an eligible alternative.
